Row.Text: [ICON_INFLUENCE] Resting Points of all Major Civilizations:

You became an Ally of [COLOR_CYAN]{1_CS}[ENDCOLOR] and you are first in queue to benefit from the knowledge, technologies, experience and informations of its citizens. Watch for the new bonuses from this City-State.
City-State's Alliance bonuses!

You established an Embassy in [COLOR_CYAN]{1_CS}[ENDCOLOR], therefore you gain a permanent access to the knowledge, technologies, experience and informations of its citizens. Remember that this connection is lost if you are at war with this City-State! Watch for the new bonuses from this City-State.
City-State's permanent bonuses from an Embassy!

Now [COLOR_CYAN]{1_CS}[ENDCOLOR] is under your influence, so you may benefit from the knowledge, technologies, experience and informations of its citizens. Watch for the new bonuses from this City-State.
Overwhelming influence with a City-State!
A Shift in Alliance
([COLOR:205:255:105:255]Affable[ENDCOLOR])
([COLOR_WHITE]Pragmatic[ENDCOLOR])
([COLOR_RED]Reclusive[ENDCOLOR])
([COLOR:240:105:255:255]Enigmatic[ENDCOLOR])
Terrified
[COLOR_LIGHT_GREY]City-State's bonuses given to Major Player:[ENDCOLOR]
[COLOR_LIGHT_GREY]City-State's passive abilities:[ENDCOLOR]
[COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Diplomatic Marriage[ENDCOLOR] available!
[ICON_STRENGTH] Protected by: [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]{1_Protectors}[ENDCOLOR]
[ICON_WAR] At war with: [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]{1_AtWarWith}[ENDCOLOR]
Unique Unit: [COLOR_YIELD_GOLD]{1_Unique_Unit}[ENDCOLOR] available at [ICON_RESEARCH] [COLOR_CYAN]{2_Tech}[ENDCOLOR].

Unfortunately, we couldn't replace [COLOR_CYAN]{1_CS}[ENDCOLOR] with any other City-State due to coding limitations we couldn't pass. If you don't want to see two cities of the same name in your game (or conflicting leaders), then we can only recommend to start the game over. Good luck!
UNAVOIDABLE CONFLICT!!! RESTART REQUIRED...
We've managed to replace a conflicting City-State with another one. To achieve full functionality and to avoid unnecessary problems, please save your current game and reload it. Enjoy the game!
CONFLICT RESOLVED! RELOAD REQUIRED...
You received new [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]{1_UnitName}[ENDCOLOR] unit from [COLOR_CYAN]{2_CS}[ENDCOLOR] as a gratitude for great cooperation and friendly attitutde.
Civilians arrived from friendly City-State!

[COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]{1_CS}[ENDCOLOR] has created a great work for you. [COLOR_MAGENTA]{2_GWType}[ENDCOLOR] should fill your collection in [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]{3_Building}[ENDCOLOR] and grant you an unusual cultural experience.
New masterpiece arrived!

Your unit wasn't aware of [COLOR:6:82:255:255]Nihang[ENDCOLOR]'s secret weapon, small golden trident called [COLOR:6:82:255:255]Trehsool Mukh[ENDCOLOR], hidden in his turban. Unfortunately this unexpected riposte was deadly for your unit. Be more careful next time!
Nihang's revenge!

With new technologies discovered and new [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]{1_Building}[ENDCOLOR] built you can ensure, that your [COLOR:6:82:255:255]Nihang[ENDCOLOR] units will take part in additional training programs, that will keep them up with the changing situation on the war front. They can safely gain additional experience and be ready for upcoming combat.
Special training program for Nihangs!

Season has started and myriads of [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Te'aats[ENDCOLOR] from [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Juyubit}[ENDCOLOR] sailed away to spread culture around the world, and to bring part of the haul to you. Their recent festival gave you additional {2_Food} [ICON_FOOD] Food and {3_Culture} [ICON_CULTURE] Culture in [COLOR_CYAN]{4_City}[ENDCOLOR].
Great event on the sea!

Transit through a Cape of Good Hope is very lucrative business. The secret deal with [COLOR_CYAN]{1_CapeTown}[ENDCOLOR] guarantees that some part of the revenues are rerouted to your pocket as an additional profit. Treat this as a payment for security? Nevertheless, you are now richer by {2_Gold} [ICON_GOLD].
Cape of Good Hope!

Travelling with the experienced navigators from [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Manila}[ENDCOLOR] allows you to find curious selling markets for your exotic goods. Your merchants pack another bunch of crates filled with some food and raw materials worth {2_FoodAndProduction} [ICON_FOOD] and [ICON_PRODUCTION].
Pearl of the Orient!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Quebec}[ENDCOLOR] is full of companies experienced in logging industry. Thanks to their contacts you can get better deals and sell goods you have just acquired for better prices. [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR] gains additional {3_Yields} [ICON_PRODUCTION] and [ICON_GOLD] for the removed [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]{4_Feature}[ENDCOLOR].
Crucial support from logging companies!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Sydney}[ENDCOLOR] is known from organizing huge and spectacular events. Many artists and creators arrive there to present their works to the wider audience. Because [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR] is about to glorify your rulings, these people were redirected to your city instead, increasing the progress towards [ICON_GREAT_ARTIST] {3_GreatArtist}, [ICON_GREAT_WRITER] {4_GreatWriter} and [ICON_GREAT_MUSICIAN] {5_GreatMusician} by {6_PointsArtist} [ICON_GREAT_PEOPLE], {7_PointsWriter} [ICON_GREAT_PEOPLE] and {8_PointsMusician} [ICON_GREAT_PEOPLE] respectively.
Creators boom!

Because [COLOR_CYAN]{1_CityOfTrade}[ENDCOLOR] has finished another trade mission recently, [COLOR_CYAN]{2_Colombo}[ENDCOLOR] can carefully count all the profits. Its great experience can be used to restructure your army and increase the defenses of the whole trade network, [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]healing all your units by 10 HP[ENDCOLOR].
Special care trade partners!

Merchants from [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Genoa}[ENDCOLOR] look for every opportunity to become rich and to introduce their hometown into an age of prosperity. Their last target, [COLOR_CYAN]{2_GreatPerson}[ENDCOLOR], might help with that generating unexpected profits. Its recent actions grant you additional {3_Gold} [ICON_GOLD] and {4_GoldenAge} [ICON_GOLDEN_AGE].
Golden people!

One of your citizens, lured by wealth and prosperity of huge metropolis, migrated from [COLOR_CYAN]{1_YourCity}[ENDCOLOR] to [COLOR_CYAN]{2_HongKongCity}[ENDCOLOR]. [COLOR_CYAN]{3_HongKong}[ENDCOLOR] really appreciates that sacrifice and has prepared something in return. You receive {4_Gold} [ICON_GOLD] and what's more, you should feel a significant warming of billateral contacts boosted by {5_Influence} [ICON_INFLUENCE] Influence.
Welcome to {1_HongKong}![NEWLINE]

Wise diplomats from [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Singapore}[ENDCOLOR] finished their negotiations with a great success giving you a nice relationship boost in [COLOR_CYAN]{2_InfluencedCityState}[ENDCOLOR], but there's more! They also managed to acquire some fundings for your upcoming projects from local companies. Your treasury enriches by {3_Gold} [ICON_GOLD].
Diplomatic success!

"Did you know about [COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]{1_WorldWonder}[ENDCOLOR]? No?! Then don't hesitate and come to {2_City} to see it!" [COLOR_CYAN]{3_Tyre}[ENDCOLOR] is purely admired by your efforts and advertises your recent construction on each corner of their small city. Soon you should welcome first wave of visitors and bare with increasing tourism traffic estimated at {4_Tourism} [ICON_TOURISM].
[COLOR_YIELD_FOOD]{1_WorldWonder}[ENDCOLOR] open for visitors!
Experienced and careful bankers from [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Zurich}[ENDCOLOR] found few discrepencies in your spendings and saved you {2_Interests} [ICON_GOLD] only in last {3_Turns} turns!
Money in the right hands!

Your partnership with [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Zurich}[ENDCOLOR] finally ends, so is the inevitably helpful support from their bankers. Be sure to establish an embassy or try to improve your relationship with them to encourage them to work for you again. In last {2_Turns} turns they managed to save you {3_Interests} [ICON_GOLD]. How could you let them go?!

Your partnership with [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Zurich}[ENDCOLOR] finally ends, so is the inevitably helpful support from their bankers. Be sure to establish an embassy or try to improve your relationship with them to encourage them to work for you again. Unfortunately we lost all of our data about your latest savings, but we promise to keep better in the future!
Your treasury is endangered!

Your military power is unquestionnable. [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Sidon}[ENDCOLOR] knows only one way of resolving conflicts and that's why it is under huge impression of your recent actions and pledge loyalty to you in the form of a [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Sphere of Influence[ENDCOLOR].
Friends in needs!

Your liberation efforts don't go unrewarded and this is why [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Bogota}[ENDCOLOR] awes you! It does not skimp on money and rewards you with multiple precious artifacts worth {2_Culture} [ICON_CULTURE]. What will you do with them?
United independence!

You could have liberated that city, but... at least you can make lives of these people easier under your glorious rule, can't you? [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Bogota}[ENDCOLOR] encourages you to continue the mission giving you a small consolation prize worth {2_Culture} [ICON_CULTURE]. It still hopes you can help it unite the world.
United independence?

Beautiful [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Florence}[ENDCOLOR] is a home of numerous artists and engineers, who create outstanding works each day and night. One of them, [COLOR_CYAN]{2_GreatPerson}[ENDCOLOR], decided to work for you! Let's hope it is not the last one.
[COLOR_CYAN]{1_GreatPerson}[ENDCOLOR] looks for a job!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Kyzyl}[ENDCOLOR] as a huge industrial and academic center of the region heavily supports your production efforts and redistributes some specialists around your country. Its recent actions result in following production boosts: {2_CityList}
Scientists share their knowledge!

The clergy from [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Prague}[ENDCOLOR] value your loss of a [COLOR_CYAN]{2_LostUnit}[ENDCOLOR], who was trying to convert pagans and infidels to your religion. To compensate this tragic event and encourage you to continue such desired missions, they buy from you few relics worth {3_Faith} [ICON_PEACE] and {4_Culture} [ICON_CULTURE].
Glorious death during a mission!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Geneva}[ENDCOLOR] is a city of chances for those brave men and women, who seek for a change in their lives. Many educated personas arrive here to help in improving the city and create an ideal society. For example, [COLOR_CYAN]{2_GreatPerson}[ENDCOLOR] came here today, enriching the rituals of local religious community with {3_Faith} [ICON_PEACE].
Good place to live!

Recently trained [COLOR_CYAN]{1_DiploUnit}[ENDCOLOR] supported by shamans from [COLOR_CYAN]{2_Ife}[ENDCOLOR] is solidly prepared to conduct wise diplomatic actions and also to perform some magical rituals that may help in difficult negotiations giving you {3_Faith} [ICON_PEACE].
Yoruba diplomacy!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_JerusalemCity}[ENDCOLOR] has just adopted {2_ReligionIcon} [COLOR_CYAN]{3_ReligionName}[ENDCOLOR] as you did long time ago. Now they spread your word over the world with force and devotion you have never expected.
Infidels converted!

In recognition and awe of your holiness, the leaders of [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Jerusalem}[ENDCOLOR] pledge their loyalty to you in the form of a [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Sphere of Influence[ENDCOLOR]. Let the common religion bond these two countries together for centuries.
Religious pretectorate!

[COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Potala Palace[ENDCOLOR] shines from the top of the hill hosting magnificient Dalai Lama. Citizens of [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Lhasa}[ENDCOLOR] awe you for your recent cunstruction efforts. They swear loyality and offer you services in return for the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Sphere of Influence[ENDCOLOR].
You are our wonder!

You hired a [COLOR_CYAN]{1_SwissGuard}[ENDCOLOR] from [COLOR_CYAN]{2_Vatican}[ENDCOLOR]. Its military value is rather negligible, yet it cannot be totally ignored. But what's more important you can use its devotion and huge sacrifice to generate something really valuable - an extraordinary religious experience and safety of the most prominent religious nobles.

You hired a [COLOR_CYAN]{1_SwissGuard}[ENDCOLOR] from [COLOR_CYAN]{2_Vatican}[ENDCOLOR]. Its military value is rather negligible, yet it cannot be totally ignored. But what's more important you can use its devotion and huge sacrifice to generate something really valuable - an extraordinary religious and cultural experience and safety of the most prominent religious nobles. Send your kind word to the world. God bless the [COLOR_CYAN]Radio[ENDCOLOR]!

You hired a [COLOR_CYAN]{1_SwissGuard}[ENDCOLOR] from [COLOR_CYAN]{2_Vatican}[ENDCOLOR]. Its military value is rather negligible, yet it cannot be totally ignored. But what's more important you can use its devotion and huge sacrifice to generate something really valuable - an extraordinary religious and cultural experience and safety of the most prominent religious nobles. Send your kind word to the world to bring the as many faithful to your sacred places as possible. God bless the [COLOR_CYAN]Radio[ENDCOLOR] and all kinds of [COLOR_CYAN]Telecommunications[ENDCOLOR]!
Guard the Pope!

Successful conquests are something [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Levuka}[ENDCOLOR] seeks. Those who fulfill its hunger for expansion will be gratified with some exotic goods. All your cities receive {2_Food} [ICON_FOOD].
Expansion needs a special care!

Another barbarian settlement is turned into dust! [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Levuka}[ENDCOLOR] shares with you some supplies found inside the barracks that few hours ago were home to these bloody bastards. Each of your cities receives {2_Food} [ICON_FOOD].
Bloody barbarian camp cleared!

Wise lords from [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Yangcheng}[ENDCOLOR] want to celebrate the Chinese New Year together and share all of the upcoming perks with you. Enrich your religious rituals with additional {2_Faith} [ICON_PEACE] and be grateful to your new [COLOR_CULTURE_STORED]{3_Animal}[ENDCOLOR] patron, which grants you {4_BonusYields} in your [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital.
Year of the {1_Animal}!

Practices performed by [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Camutins}[ENDCOLOR] adapt the environment around. Soil becomes much more fertile and keeps its quality for ages. They share their techniques with you greatly improving your agricultural skills. [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR] gains permanent +2 [ICON_FOOD].
Environmental changes!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Camutins}[ENDCOLOR] always expanded their territory to lands that could support their future developement. It's a great sign you are following their path. [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR] acquired {3_Tiles} new tile{4_Plural} containing [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Flood Plains[ENDCOLOR] or [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Lakes[ENDCOLOR].
Fresh water found!

Good time has finally come to you. Intrigued [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Honiara}[ENDCOLOR] observes that with excitement. They are experienced fishermen, but they also know what are the possible field harvests, and they do not complain, when they are low. They appreciate that Gods made this season rich for you, and share additional {2_Food} [ICON_FOOD] in the [COLOR_CYAN]{3_City}[ENDCOLOR]. You should dance with these people and thank the Gods, too!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Honiara}[ENDCOLOR] is shocked with your recent successful sea harvests. They are very experienced fishermen, but what you just did is beyond their expectations. They praise the Gods, who made this season so abundant. That's why they moved to your stocks in the [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR] inmense {3_Food} [ICON_FOOD]. It's more than usual. Let's dance with these people to thank your Gods, too!
Let's dance!

New era is always a gigantic strength boost for [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Irunea}[ENDCOLOR]. Doubled efforts mean, that your youngest city, [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR], receives a [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Workboat[ENDCOLOR] to support you in further developement. Send it to open waters in search of riches!
Basques celebrate a new beginning!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Irunea}[ENDCOLOR] leaders crave for fast economic expansion on new unexplored coastal territories, surely full of profitable resources. They constructed a [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Workboat[ENDCOLOR] and passed it to your recently founded city, [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR], so its developement could be boosted right away.
Basques supports a new colony!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Kariatebike}[ENDCOLOR] shares with you significant part of its stock of [ICON_RES_COPRA] Copra. Use it wisely, and remember to maintain good relations with it, becuase you will loose this precious exotic good when the alliance is gone.
Copra resource available![NEWLINE]
Because your relations with [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Kariatebike}[ENDCOLOR] significantly dropped, they decided to stop supporting you with the precious [ICON_RES_COPRA] Copra. Do you have a backup plan?!
End of trade![NEWLINE]

Unique techniques of the cold fire, possessed and mastered by [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Mendyarrup}[ENDCOLOR], used to clear the undergrowth without destroying upper part of the forest, significantly speeds up your city's growth. [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR] can distribute {3_Food} [ICON_FOOD] to support your citizen's efforts.
Clear path!

New life is something you should defend at all costs. Thanks to a cooperation with [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Mendyarrup}[ENDCOLOR] you know how to effectively direct this mobilizing force into the minds of your soldiers. [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR] spreads the news to {3_NumUnits} units stationing nearby granting them 2 XP.
Strength for the people!

People of the far north master their hunting techniques for centuries, and now they share them with you. [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Okak}[ENDCOLOR] lures one majestic creature to your neighbourhood, increasing their population in your empire to {2_Whales} [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whale{3_Plural}.

Now, when you know these indigenous tribes are the true masters of the hunt, they leave you with that knowledge and sail away. It was the last, fifth [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whale [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Okak}[ENDCOLOR] brought to your lands.
Whale hunting begins![NEWLINE]

One of your units, [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Unit}[ENDCOLOR] was not careful enough during its march through vast desert areas. It entered a trap set by nomadic people of [COLOR_CYAN]{2_Abalessa}[ENDCOLOR], loyal to your enemy [COLOR_CYAN]{3_MajorPlayer}[ENDCOLOR], who rules over this region. This will significantly delay your campaign.
It's a trap![NEWLINE]

Nomadic tribes like [COLOR_CYAN]{1_AlTirabin}[ENDCOLOR] are experts in trade, and they will surely support your efforts to widen the caravan network crossing their desert settlements, granting you [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]{2_Number} additional [ICON_INTERNATIONAL_TRADE] Trade Route{3_Plural}[ENDCOLOR].

New era, means you can diversify your assortment. And this is what nomadic tribes like [COLOR_CYAN]{1_AlTirabin}[ENDCOLOR] pursue the most! They are experts in trade, and they will surely support your efforts to widen the caravan network crossing their desert settlements, granting you [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]an additional [ICON_INTERNATIONAL_TRADE] Trade Route[ENDCOLOR].
Nomadic life!

Sailors from [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Hanuabada}[ENDCOLOR] are true heroes! It could be a death sentence for an unexperienced man to sail like they do, but thanks to their advices, you return safely with traded exotic goods. Women start dancing seeing your silhouette on the horizon, granting you {2_GoldenAgePoints} [ICON_GOLDEN_AGE].
Hiri trade cycle!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Baghcasaray}[ENDCOLOR] is known of its prosperous slave market full of innocent people kidnapped from their homes. Because of your long-term relationship, they give you one of their strongest slaves, and he immediately starts working for you in [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR] as a free man.
Slave captured!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Longyan}[ENDCOLOR] shared their latest design of a [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Tulou[ENDCOLOR], which behaves like a small self-sufficient city. Its construction allowed you to increase the population capacity of [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR], and the effect can be seen immediately!
Good place to live!

It's not probably the most elegant and human way to treat your opponent's corpses like that, but [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Waitukubuli}[ENDCOLOR] taught you that no food can be wasted. That's why you have to prepare their bodies for their last journey, to [COLOR_CYAN]{3_City}[ENDCOLOR], securing {2_Food} [ICON_FOOD] Food for harsh times.
Cannibalism!

Councellors from [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Ayutthaya}[ENDCOLOR] advised you to declare war. Now to achieve all of your goals you must almost instantly adjust all industrial sectors, so they could fulfill huge demands of the accelerating war machine. Your recent actions gave you {2_Production} [ICON_PRODUCTION] in each City. Time to find more!
Set the production to war tempo!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Ayutthaya}[ENDCOLOR] knows that feeling very well. Being attacked by nations hungry for new territories or precious resources. Their experience gave you more than enough knowledge to prepare a counterplan on time. You could change training plans to gain a new ambitious leader, that will accompany your troops to the battlefield. Your court gains {2_GreatGeneralPoints} [ICON_GREAT_GENERAL] Great General Points.
Full mobilization!

Experienced Siida people from [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Karasjohka}[ENDCOLOR] know how to find and lure [ICON_RES_REINDEER] [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Reindeers[ENDCOLOR] to your territory. They only need a piece of inhabitted tundra and some forest nearby to make these animals come to them without any special effort! Now you can join Siida to admire these beautiful creatures together.
Beautiful herd seen close to your territories![NEWLINE]
You are so lucky! Favourable conditions allowed [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Karasjohka}[ENDCOLOR] to lure more than one herd of [ICON_RES_REINDEER] [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Reindeers[ENDCOLOR] at a time!
Another herd nearby![NEWLINE]

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Sanandaj}[ENDCOLOR] once again is thrown into the diplomatic storm, but, as history has shown before, it knows how to move the odds onto their side. Use freshly recruited and experienced [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Envoy[ENDCOLOR] to gain the advantage over your rivals.
New challenges of the upcoming era!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Sanandaj}[ENDCOLOR] is grateful for your recent diplomatic efforts. Training the [COLOR_CYAN]{2_Unit}[ENDCOLOR] over military unit is always a tough choice, but you chose the right peaceful path. It awards you with precious artifacts worth {3_Culture} [ICON_CULTURE].
Diplomacy is the key!

Collectioners from [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Vaduz}[ENDCOLOR] found a fantastic artistic creation and immediately invested some money to buy it. This way [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR] gained {3_Points} [ICON_GREAT_PEOPLE] towards a [COLOR_CYAN]{4_GreatPerson}[ENDCOLOR] allowing for even faster cultural developement.
Art purchases!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Victoria}[ENDCOLOR]'s industry is strongly tied to coasts. That's why they offered you a significant help in developing crucial maritime areas of your empire by [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]improving {2_Count} sea resource{3_Plural} in {4_Cities} cit{5_SecondPlural}[ENDCOLOR].

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Victoria}[ENDCOLOR]'s industry is strongly tied to coasts. That's why they offered you some help in developing your new maritime areas by [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]improving {2_Count} sea resource{3_Plural}[ENDCOLOR] in [COLOR_CYAN]{4_City}[ENDCOLOR].

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Victoria}[ENDCOLOR]'s industry is strongly tied to coasts. That's why they offered you some help in developing recently acquired area by improving {2_ResIcon} [COLOR_CYAN]{3_ResName}[ENDCOLOR] in [COLOR_CYAN]{4_City}[ENDCOLOR].
God bless developement!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Gondar}[ENDCOLOR] knows no mercy for their enemies! Thanks to their spies you know where to hit, so it really hurts. Destroyed [COLOR_CYAN]{2_Improvement}[ENDCOLOR] starts a domino effect damaging nearby [COLOR_CYAN]{3_City}[ENDCOLOR] for {4_Damage} HP.

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Gondar}[ENDCOLOR] knows no mercy for their enemies! It's a pity your enemy has good relationship with it. Its spies infiltrated your lands and found weakest points of your defenses. Destroyed [COLOR_CYAN]{2_Improvement}[ENDCOLOR] starts a domino effect damaging one of your cities, [COLOR_CYAN]{3_City}[ENDCOLOR], for {4_Damage} HP.
Burn in flames![NEWLINE]

With multiple investments in your military power you can guarantee the safety of local paths and trade routes of your empire. [COLOR_CYAN]{1_Ngazargamu}[ENDCOLOR] praises the God for that, and he returns to them with kind words and promising prophecies, increasing your faith by {2_Faith} [ICON_PEACE].
God is the only one you should fear!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_Saddarvazeh}[ENDCOLOR] prays to the Zoroaster for help in spreading the word to different nations. Thanks to their devotion, after long time of empty slogans, their voices were finally heard and awarded with a new ambitious [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Missionary[ENDCOLOR], who is immediately put under your command in [COLOR_CYAN]{2_City}[ENDCOLOR]. Use it wisely!
Zoroaster speaks!

[COLOR_CYAN]{1_SambaaKe}[ENDCOLOR] dances on each occasion and they treat it like a remedy for everything. They dance when they are sad or happy. They use dance to fight evil ghosts and to provide good odds. You should dance, too! Teach your people how to do it with these talented teachers providing permanent +3% [ICON_GREAT_MUSICIAN] Great Musician Points in all cities.
Calm your soul!
